criteria.exact: all requested NEW label/kind/quantity pairs exactly once, no extras
criteria.structural_invalid: HTTP success with invalid response/closed slots is INVALID, never semantic failure or success
criteria.transport_unknown: all HTTP failures or missing responses stay separately UNKNOWN/INVALID
criteria.comparison: per case and repeat, compare semantic correctness only when both cells have valid transport and contract; contract-rate differences separate
interpretation: Repeat-consistent condition differences support a next finite hypothesis, not a unique internal mechanism.
Mixed changes or mixed repetitions mean no stable distinction.
All equal means this diagnostic did not distinguish conditions.
No fresh-quality, ordinary-UI, renderer, full-Type or general efficacy claim.
